evidence.quote: Returns a list of all users for the Enterprise
supports marker-based pagination using the `marker` parameter
To retrieve events for the entire enterprise, set the `stream_type` to `admin_logs_streaming`
Returns up to a year of past events for a given user or for the entire enterprise.

assumptions: Only the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow is described in the source. Box also offers server-side options (JWT or client credentials) that survive a person leaving, but the source does not document them, so they are not listed.
Box has no per-user last-login field in the user record, so usage comes from the enterprise event log. This needs an admin user and an app with the 'manage enterprise properties' scope.
The page sizes (1000 for users, 500 for events) are not stated in the source. They are sensible guesses.
User paging uses usemarker=true with next_marker. The source says marker paging is supported but does not show the exact request details.
Event paging uses stream_position and next_stream_position. The source does not describe this explicitly; it is based on the response fields and parameters.
The source does not say when the event log ends, so the last page is detected by an empty or missing next position.
Box 'cannot_delete_edit' statuses are treated as active. The source does not say what they mean.
User type (member, guest, service) is not mapped. The source has no clear field for it. The 'is_platform_access_only' flag may mark app users.
The source does not state rate limits or whether any plan is required, so those are left empty.
Events are matched to users by the Box user id of the person who triggered the event (created_by.id).
